title: New Dance { Ocean Wave Of Joy}
author: Don Flaherty
problems: Row 2 "half poussette - larks pull partners back then right larks back up so the robins are in center of long ocean wave with the larks on the other side of set facing partner, robins take right hands left hand to the next to form ocean wave in center (this is only a quarter of a poussette)" can't start from where the dancers are: Going right after backing up would take the pair out of the minor set.
Row 5 "half poussette - robins pull partners back then left" can't start from where the dancers are: Going left after backing up would take the pair out of the minor set.

Row 10 "larks allemande right 1¾ to form long ocean wave in center,giving left hand to the next larks facing partner on the out side of set" can't start from where the dancers are: This allemande does not end facing across, in long waves.
Row 12 "larks allemande right ¾ to long ocean wave in center" can't start from where the dancers are: This allemande does not end facing across, in long waves.
choices: Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
Give & take: half the beats to cross, half to back home holding both hands.
